title: God is Light
long_title: God is Light, Light is Love, Being Light

versions.nirv: This is the message we heard from Jesus and are announcing to you. God is light. There is no darkness at all in him.
versions.leb: And this is the message that we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.
versions.original: Καὶ ἔστιν ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν καὶ σκοτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδεμία.

versions.nirv: The heavens tell about the glory of God. The skies show that his hands made them. Day after day they speak. Night after night they show what they know. They do not use words. They do not use any language. Their voice is not heard. Yet their voice goes out into the whole earth. Their words reach to the ends of the world. In the heavens God has pitched a tent for the sun. It is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber. It is like a champion rejoicing to run his course. It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its way to the other. Nothing is hidden from its heat. The law of the Lord is perfect. It brings new life. The statutes of the Lord are trustworthy. They make simple people wise. The orders of the Lord are right. They bring joy to the heart. The commands of the Lord are radiant. They give light to the eyes. The fear of the Lord is pure. It lasts forever. The rules of the Lord are true. They are all right. They are more precious than gold. They are worth much more than pure gold. They are sweeter than honey. They are sweeter than honey dripping from the comb. By them your servant is warned. Keep them, and you will receive a great reward. Who can know all their errors? Forgive my hidden faults. Keep me from sins of pride. Do not let them rule over me. Then I will be pure. I will be free from heavy sin. May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, Lord. You are my Rock and my Redeemer.
versions.leb: The heavens declare the glory of God, and the expanse proclaims the work of his hands. Day to day pours forth speech, and night to night reveals knowledge. There is no speech, and there are no words; their voice is not heard. Their measuring line goes out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun, which is like a bridegroom coming out from his wedding chamber; it rejoices like a warrior to run its course. Its rising is from the ends of the heavens, and its circuit to their ends, and nothing is hidden from its heat. The law of Yahweh is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of Yahweh is trustworthy, making wise the simple. The precepts of Yahweh are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of Yahweh is radiant, enlightening the eyes. The fear of Yahweh is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of Yahweh are true, they are righteous altogether. They are more desirable than gold, than much fine gold; and sweeter than honey, and drippings of the honeycomb. Moreover, your servant is warned by them; in keeping them there is a great reward. Who can discern errors? Absolve me from hidden faults. Also keep back your servant from insolent sins; do not let them rule over me. Then I will be blameless, and I will be innocent of great transgression. Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before you, Yahweh, my rock and my redeemer.
versions.original: הַשָּׁמַיִם מְסַפְּרִים כְּבֹוד־אֵל וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו מַגִּיד הָרָקִיעַ׃ יֹום לְיֹום יַבִּיעַ אֹמֶר וְלַיְלָה לְלַיְלָה יְחַוֶּה־דָּעַת׃ אֵין־אֹמֶר וְאֵין דְּבָרִים בְּלִי נִשְׁמָע קֹולָם׃ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ יָצָא קַוָּם וּבִקְצֵה תֵבֵל מִלֵּיהֶם לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שָׂם־אֹהֶל בָּהֶם׃ וְהוּא כְּחָתֹן יֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתֹו יָשִׂשׂ כְּגִבֹּור לָרוּץ אֹרַח׃ מִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם מֹוצָאֹו וּTְקוּפָתֹו עַל־קְצֹותָם וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מֵחַמָּתֹו׃ תֹּורַת יְהוָה תְּמִימָה מְשִׁיבַת נָפֶשׁ עֵדוּת יְהוָה נֶאֱמָנָה מַחְכִּימַת פֶּתִי׃ פִּקּוּדֵי יְהוָה יְשָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי لֵב מِצְוַת יְהוָה בָּרָה מָאִירַת עֵינָיִם׃ יִרְאַת יְהוָה טְהֹורָה עֹומَدַת لَعَد مִשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָה אֱמֶת צָדְקוּ יַחְדָּו׃ הַנֶּחֱמָדִים מִזָּהָב וּמִפַּז רָב וּמתֻקִׁים מִדְּבַשׁ וְנֹפֶת צוּפִים׃ גַּם־עַבְדְּךָ נִזְהָר בְּהָשְׁמָרָם עֵקֶב רָב׃ פְּגִיאֹות מִי יָבִין מִنּِسְתָּרֹות נַקֵּנִי׃ גַּם מִזֵּדִים חֲשֹׂךְ עַבְדְּךָ אַل־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִי אָז אِיתָם וְנִקֵּיתִי מְּפֶשַׁע רָב׃ יִהְיוּ לְרָצֹון אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיֹון لِبִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי׃

versions.nirv: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill can't be hidden. Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand. Then it gives light to everyone in the house. In the same way, let your light shine so that others may see it. Then they will see the good things you do. And they will praise your Father who is in heaven.
versions.leb: You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden. Nor do they light a lamp and put it under the basket, but on the lampstand, and it shines for all who are in the house. In the same way, let your light shine before people, so that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
versions.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου. οὐ δύναται πόλις κρυβῆναι ἐπάνω ὄρους κειμένη· οὐδὲ καίουσιν λύχνον καὶ τιθέασιν αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον ἀλλ' ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν, καὶ λάμπει πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ. οὕτως λαμψάτω τὸ φῶς ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὅπως ἴδωσιν ὑμῶν τὰ καλὰ ἔργα καὶ δοξάσωσιν τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν τὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

versions.nirv: This is the message we heard from Jesus and are announcing to you. God is light. There is no darkness at all in him. Suppose we claim that we share in life with him. But suppose we keep on walking in the darkness. Then we are liars. We are not living out the truth. But suppose we walk in the light, just as he is in the light. Then we share in life with one another. And the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.
versions.leb: And this is the message that we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all. If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth. But if we walk in the light as he himself is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.
versions.original: Καὶ ἔστιν ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν καὶ σκοτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδεμία. ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ σκότει περιπατῶμεν, ψευdόμεθα καὶ οὐ ποιοῦμεν τὴν ἀλήθειαν· ἐὰν δὲ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ περιπατῶμεν ὡς αὐτός ἐστιν ἐν τῷ φωτί, κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετ' ἀλλήλων, καὶ τὸ αἷμα Ἰησοῦ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καθαρίζει ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας.

versions.nirv: God said, "Let there be lights in the vaulted-sky. Let them separate the day from the night. Let them serve as signs to mark times and days and years."
versions.leb: And God said, "Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to separate the day from the night, and let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and years,"
versions.original: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יְהִי מְאֹרֹת בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַיֹּום וּבֵין הַלָּיְלָה וְהָיוּ לְאֹתֹות וְלִמְעָדִים וְלְיָמִים וְשָׁנִים׃

versions.nirv: God said, "Let there be lights in the vaulted-sky. Let them separate the day from the night. Let them serve as signs to mark times and days and years. Let them be lights in the vaulted-sky to give light on the earth." And that is what happened. God made two great lights. He made the greater light to rule the day. He made the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars. God set lights in the vaulted-sky to give light on the earth. He set them there to rule over the day and over the night. He set them to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good. There was evening, and there was morning. It was the fourth day.
versions.leb: And God said, "Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to separate the day from the night, and let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and years, and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth." And it was so. And God made the two great lights—the greater light for ruling the day and the lesser light for ruling the night—and the stars. And God placed them in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth, and to rule over the day and over the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good. And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.
versions.original: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יְהִי מְאֹרֹת בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַיֹּום וּבֵין הַלָּיְלָה וְהָיוּ לְאֹתֹות וְלִמְעָדִים וְלְיָמִים וְשָׁנִים׃ וְהָיוּ לִמְאֹרֹת בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לְהָאִיר עַל־הָאָרֶץ וְיְהִי־כֵן׃ וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַמְּאֹרֹת הַגְּדֹלִים אֶת־הַמָּאֹור הַגָּדֹל לְמֶמְשֶׁלֶת הַיֹּום וְאֶת־הַמָּאֹור הַקָּטֹן לְמֶמְשֶׁלֶת הַלַּיְלָה וְאֶת־הַכֹּוכָבִים׃ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לְהָאִיר עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃ וְלִמְשֹׁל בַּיֹּום וּבַלַּיְלָה וּלְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הָאֹור וּבֵין הַחֹשֶׁךְ וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי־טֹוב׃ וַיְהִי־עֶרֶב וַיְהִי־בֹקֶר יֹום רְבִיעִי׃

versions.nirv: Life was in him. That life was the light of all living people. The light shines in the darkness. But the darkness has not overcome it. There came a man who was sent from God. His name was John. He came as a witness. He came to testify about the light. Because of him, all people might believe. John himself was not the light. He came only to speak as a witness about the light. The true light that shines on everyone was coming into the world.
versions.leb: In him was life, and the life was the light of mankind. And the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not mastered it. There came a man sent from God, whose name was John. He came as a witness, so that he might testify about the light, so that all might believe through him. He was not the light, but came that he might testify about the light. The true light that gives light to every person was coming into the world.
versions.original: Ἐν αὐτῷ ζωὴ ἦν, καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἦν τὸ φῶς τῶν ἀνθρώπων· καὶ τὸ φῶς ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ φαίνει, καὶ ἡ σκοτία αὐτὸ οὐ κατέλαβεν. Ἐγένετο ἄνθρωπος, ἀπεσταλμένος παρὰ θεοῦ, ὄνομα αὐτῷ Ἰωάννης· οὗτος ἦλθεν εἰς μαρτυρίαν, ἵνα μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ φωτός, ἵνα πάντες πιστεύσωσιν δι' αὐτοῦ. οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖνος τὸ φῶς, ἀλλ' ἵνα μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ φωτός. Ἦν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν, ὃ φωτίζει πάντα ἄνθρωπον, ἐρχόμενον εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

versions.nirv: Jesus spoke to the people again. He said, "I am the light of the world. Anyone who follows me will never walk in darkness. They will have that light which leads to life."
versions.leb: Then Jesus spoke to them again, saying, "I am the light of the world. The one who follows me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life."
versions.original: Πάλιν οὖν αὐτοῖς ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων, Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου· ὁ ἀκολουθῶν ἐμοὶ οὐ μὴ περιπατήσῃ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ, ἀλλ' ἕξει τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς.

versions.nirv: As long as it is day, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work. While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
versions.leb: We must do the works of the one who sent me while it is day; night is coming when no one can work. As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."
versions.original: ἡμᾶς δεῖ ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πέμψαντός με ἕως ἡμέρα ἐστίν· ἔρχεται νὺξ ὅτε οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐργάζεσθαι. ὅταν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὦ, φῶς εἰμι τοῦ κόσμου.

versions.nirv: Jesus answered, "Are there not 12 hours of daylight? Anyone who walks in the daytime doesn't trip. They see by the light of this world. But anyone who walks at night trips. They do not have light in them."
versions.leb: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks in the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world. But if anyone walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him."
versions.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς, Οὐχὶ δώδεκά εἰσιν ὧραι τῆς ἡμέρας; ἐάν τις περιπατῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, οὐ προσκόπτει, ὅτι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου τούτου βλέπει· ἐάν τις δὲ περιπατῇ ἐν τῇ νυκτί, προσκόπτει, ὅτι τὸ φῶς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῷ.

versions.nirv: The crowd spoke up. They said, "We have heard from the Law that the Messiah will remain forever. So how can you say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up'? Who is this 'Son of Man'?" Jesus answered, "You are going to have the light for just a little longer. Walk while you have the light. Then the darkness won't catch up with you. Anyone who walks in the dark doesn't know where they are going. Put your trust in the light while you have it. Then you will become children of light." When Jesus had finished speaking, he left and hid from them.
versions.leb: Then the crowd answered him, "We have heard from the law that the Christ remains forever, and how can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?" So Jesus said to them, "The light is with you for a little longer. Walk while you have the light, so that the darkness does not overtake you. And the one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going. While you have the light, believe in the light, so that you may become sons of light." Jesus said these things, and he went away and hid himself from them.
versions.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος, Ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐκ τοῦ νόμου ὅτι ὁ Χριστὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· καὶ πῶς σὺ λέγεις ὅτι δεῖ ὑψωθῆναι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου; τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου; εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, Ἔτι μικρὸν χρόνον τὸ φῶς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐστιν. περιπατεῖτε ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε, ἵνα μὴ σκοτία ὑμᾶς καταλάβῃ· καὶ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει. ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε, πιστεύετε εἰς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα υἱοὶ φωτὸς γένησθε. Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἐκρύβη ἀπ' αὐτῶν.

versions.nirv: Yet I am writing a new command to you. It is true in him and in you. The darkness is passing away. The true light is already shining. Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates a brother or sister is still in the darkness. Anyone who loves a brother or sister lives in the light. There is nothing in them to make them stumble. But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness. They walk around in the darkness. They don't know where they are going. The darkness has blinded them.
versions.leb: Again, I am writing a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already shining. The one who says that he is in the light and hates his fellow countryman is in the darkness until now. The one who loves his fellow countryman resides in the light, and there is no cause for stumbling in him. But the one who hates his fellow countryman is in the darkness and walks in the darkness, and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
versions.original: Πάλιν ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ὅ ἐστιν ἀληθὲς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία παράγεται καὶ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἤδη φαίνει. Ὁ λέγων ἐν τῷ φωτὶ εἶναι καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν ἕως ἄρτι. ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ μένει, καὶ σκάνδαλον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν· ὁ δὲ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν καὶ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ περιπατεῖ, καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία ἐτύφλωσεν 15 τὰ ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ.

versions.nirv: The god of this age has blinded the minds of those who do not believe. They cannot see the light of the good news. The good news tells about the glory of Christ, who is the exact likeness of God. We do not preach about ourselves. We preach about Jesus Christ as Lord. We say that we are your servants for Jesus' sake. God said, "Let light shine out of darkness." He made his light shine in our hearts. He gave us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory. That glory shines in the face of Christ.
versions.leb: in whom the god of this age has blinded the minds of the unbelievers, so that the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, would not shine on them. For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus' sake. For God, who said "Light shall shine out of darkness," is the one who shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Christ.
versions.original: ἐν οἷς ὁ θεὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἐτύφλωσεν τὰ νοήματα τῶν ἀπίστων εἰς τὸ μὴ αὐγάσαι τὸν φωτισμὸν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς δόξης τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ θεοῦ. οὐ γὰρ ἑαυτοὺς κηρύσσομεν ἀλλὰ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν κύριον, ἑαυτοὺς δὲ δούλους ὑμῶν διὰ Ἰησοῦν· ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ὁ εἰπὼν Ἐκ σκότους φῶς λάμψει, ὃς ἔλαμψεν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν πρὸς φωτισμὸν τῆς γνώσεως τῆς δόξης τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν προσώπῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

versions.nirv: One of the seven angels had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues. He came over and said to me, "Come. I will show you the bride. She is the wife of the Lamb." He carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain that was huge and high. He showed me the Holy City, Jerusalem. It was coming down out of heaven from God. It shone with the glory of God. It was like a very precious jewel. It was like a clear jasper stone. The city had a great, high wall. It had 12 gates. There were 12 angels at the gates. The names of the 12 tribes of Israel were written on the gates. There were three gates on the east. There were three on the north. There were three on the south. And there were three on the west. The wall of the city had 12 foundations. The names of the 12 apostles of the Lamb were written on them. The angel who talked with me had a measuring stick made of gold. He had it to measure the city, its gates and its wall. The city was laid out like a square. Its length was as long as its width. He measured the city with the stick. It was 1,500 miles long. Its length and width and height are equal. He also measured the wall. It was 216 feet thick, using human measurement, which the angel was using. The wall was made of jasper. The city was made of pure gold, as pure as glass. The foundations of the city wall were decorated with every kind of jewel. The first foundation was jasper. The second was sapphire. The third was agate. The fourth was emerald. The fifth was onyx. The sixth was ruby. The seventh was chrysolite. The eighth was beryl. The ninth was topaz. The tenth was turquoise. The eleventh was jacinth. The twelfth was amethyst. The 12 gates were 12 pearls. Each gate was made out of a single pearl. The main street of the city was made of pure gold, as clear as glass. I did not see a temple in the city. The Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple. The city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it. The glory of God gives it light. The Lamb is its lamp. Nations will walk by its light. The kings of the earth will bring their splendor into it. Its gates will never be shut all day long. There will be no night there. The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it. Nothing impure will ever enter it. No one who does what is shameful or lies will ever enter it. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life will enter it.
versions.leb: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and spoke with me, saying, "Come here; I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb." And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, having the glory of God. Her radiance was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal. It had a great and high wall, having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel. On the east three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates. And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb. And the one who spoke with me had a measuring rod of gold, so that he might measure the city and its gates and its wall. And the city lies square, and its length is as great as the width. And he measured the city with the rod to fifteen hundred stadia; its length and width and height are equal. And he measured its wall, a hundred and forty-four cubits by human measure, which is the angel's. And the building material of its wall was jasper, and the city was pure gold, like clear glass. The foundations of the city wall were decorated with every kind of precious stone: the first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald, the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst. And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was made from a single pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass. And I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty is its temple, and the Lamb. And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon so that they may shine on it, for the glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb. And the nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it. And its gates will never be shut by day, for there will be no night there. And they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it. And never will anything unclean enter into it, and anyone who practices detestable things and falsehood, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.
versions.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων τῶν ἐχόντων τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας τῶν γεμόντων τῶν ἑπτὰ πληγῶν τῶν ἐσχάτων, καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετὰ ἐμοῦ λέγων, Δεῦρο, δείξω σοι τὴν νύμφην τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ ἀρνίου. καὶ ἀπήνεγκέν με ἐν πνεύματι ἐπὶ ὄρος μέγα καὶ ὑψηλόσ, καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἁγίαν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καταβαίνουσαν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἔχουσαν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ· ὁ φωστὴρ αὐτῆς ὅμοιος λίθῳ τιμιωτάτῳ, ὡς λίθῳ ἰάπιδι κρυσταλλίζοντι. ἔχουσαν τεῖχος μέγα καὶ ὑψηλὸν, ἔχουσαν πυλῶνας δώδεκα, καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς πυλῶσιν ἀγγέλους δώδεκα, καὶ ὀνόματα ἐπιγεγραμμένα, ἅ ἐστιν ὀνόματα τῶν δώδεκα φυλῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς πυλῶνες τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ πυλῶνας τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ νότου πυλῶνας τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ δυσμῶν πυλῶνας τρεῖς. καὶ τὸ τεῖχος τῆς πόλεως ἔχον θεμελίους δώδεκα, καὶ ἐπ' αὐτῶν δώδεκα ὀνόματα τῶν δώδεκα ἀποστόλων τοῦ ἀρνίου. Καὶ ὁ λαλῶν μετ' ἐμοῦ εἶχεν μέτρον κάλαμον χρυσοῦν, ἵνα μετρήσῃ τὴν πόλιν καὶ τοὺς πυλῶνας αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ τεῖχος αὐτῆς. καὶ ἡ πόλις τετράγωνος κεῖται, καὶ τὸ μήκος αὐτῆς ὅσον τὸ πλάτος ἐστίν. καὶ ἐμέτρησεν τὴν πόλιν τῷ καλάμῳ ἐπὶ σταδίων δωδεκακισχιλίων· τὸ μήκος καὶ τὸ πλάτος καὶ τὸ ύψος αὐτῆς ἴσα ἐστίν. καὶ ἐμέτρησεν τὸ τεῖχος αὐτῆς ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τεσσάρων πηχῶν, μέτρον ἀνθρώπου, ὅ ἐστιν ἀγγέλου. καὶ ἡ ἐνδόμησις τοῦ τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις· καὶ ἡ πόλις χρυσίον καθαρὸν ὅμοιον ὑάλῳ καθαρῷ. οἱ θεμέλιοι τοῦ τείχους τῆς πόλεως παντὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ κεκοσμημένοι· ὁ θεμέλιος ὁ πρῶτος ἴασπις, ὁ δεύτερος σάπφειρος, ὁ τρίτος χαλκηδών, ὁ τέταρτος σμάραγδος, ὁ πέμπτος σαρδόνυξ, ὁ ἕκτος σάρδιον, ὁ ἕβδομος χρυσόλιθος, ὁ ὄγδοος βήρυλλος, ὁ ἔνατος τοπάζιον, ὁ δέκατος χρυσόπρασον, ὁ ἑνδέκατος ὑάκινθος, ὁ δωδέκατος ἀμέθυστος. καὶ οἱ δώδεκα πυλῶνες δώδεκα μαργαρῖται· ἀνὰ εἷς ἕκαστος τῶν πυλώνων ἦν ἐξ ἑνὸς μαργαρίτου. καὶ ἡ πλατεῖα τῆς πόλεως χρυσίον καθαρὸν ὡς ὕαλος διαυγής. Καὶ ναὸν οὐκ εἶδον ἐν αὐτῇ, ὁ γὰρ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ναὸς αὐτῆς ἐστιν, καὶ τὸ ἀρνίον. καὶ ἡ πόλις οὐ χρείαν ἔχει τοῦ ἡλίου οὐδὲ τῆς σελήνης ἵνα φαίνωσιν ἐν αὐτῇ, ἡ γὰρ δόξα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐφώτισεν αὐτὴν, καὶ ὁ λύχνος αὐτῆς τὸ ἀρνίον. καὶ περιπατήσουσιν τὰ ἔθνη διὰ τοῦ φωτὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς φέρουσιν τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν εἰς αὐτήν. καὶ οἱ πυλῶνες αὐτῆς οὐ μὴ κλεισθῶσιν ἡμέρας, νὺξ γὰρ οὐκ ἔσται ἐκεῖ· καὶ οἴσουσιν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰς αὐτήν. καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτὴν πᾶν κοινὸν καὶ ποιοῦν βδέλυγμα καὶ ψεῦδος, εἰ μὴ οἱ γεγραμμένοι ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ ἀρνίου.

versions.nirv: Jesus cried out, "Whoever believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me. The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me. I have come into the world as a light. So no one who believes in me should stay in darkness. "As for anyone who hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge them. For I did not come to judge the world. I came to save the world. There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words. The very words I have spoken will judge them on the last day. I did not speak on my own. Instead, the Father who sent me commanded me what to say and how to say it. I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say."
versions.leb: Then Jesus cried out and said, "The one who believes in me does not believe in me, but in the one who sent me. And the one who sees me sees the one who sent me. I have come as a light into the world, so that everyone who believes in me should not remain in the darkness. And if anyone hears my words and does not keep them, I do not judge him, for I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world. The one who rejects me and does not accept my words has one who judges him: the word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day. For I have not spoken from myself, but the Father who sent me has himself given me a commandment, what to say and what to speak. And I know that his commandment is eternal life. Therefore, what I speak, just as the Father has told me, so I speak."
versions.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἔκραξεν καὶ εἶπεν, Ὁ πιστεύων εἱς ἐμὲ οὐ πιστεύει εἰς ἐμὲ ἀλλὰ εἰς τὸν πέμψαντά με· καὶ ὁ θεωρῶν ἐμὲ θεωρεῖ τὸν πέμψαντά με. ἐγὼ φῶς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐλήλυθα, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ μὴ μείνῃ. καὶ ἐάν τίς μου ἀκούσῃ τῶν ῥημάτων καὶ μὴ φυλάξῃ, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω αὐτόν· οὐ γὰρ ἦλθον ἵνα κρίνω τὸν κόσμον, ἀλλ' ἵνα σώσω τὸν κόσμον. ὁ ἀθετῶν ἐμὲ καὶ μὴ λαμβάνων τὰ ῥήματά μου ἔχει τὸν κρίνοντα αὐτόν· ὁ λόγος ὃν ἐλάλησεν, ἐκεῖνος κρινεῖ αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ. ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐξ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλάλησα, ἀλλ' ὁ πέμψας με πατὴρ αὐτός μοι ἐντολὴν δέδωκεν τί εἴπω καὶ τί λαλήσω. καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἡ ἐντολὴ αὐτοῦ ζωὴ αἰώνιός ἐστιν. ἃ οὖν ἐγὼ λαλῶ, καθὼς εἴρηκέν μοι ὁ πατήρ, οὕτως λαλῶ.

versions.nirv: "Lord, now you are letting your servant go in peace. You have kept your promise. With my own eyes I have seen your salvation. You have prepared it in the sight of all nations. It is a light to shine on the Gentiles. It is the glory of your people Israel."
versions.leb: "Now, Master, you are dismissing your servant in peace, according to your word, because my eyes have seen your salvation, that you have prepared in the presence of all peoples, a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel."
versions.original: Νῦν ἀπολύεις τὸν δοῦλόν σου, δέσποτα, κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἐν εἰρήνῃ· ὅτι εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου τὸ σωτήριόν σου, ὃ ἡτοίμασας κατὰ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν λαῶν, φῶς εἰς ἀποκάλυψιν ἐθνῶν καὶ δόξαν λαοῦ σου Ἰσραήλ.

versions.nirv: He is the only one who cannot die. He lives in light that no one can go near. No one has ever seen him. No one can ever see him. Honor and power belong to him forever. Amen.
versions.leb: the only one who has immortality, who dwells in unapproachable light, whom no human has seen nor is able to see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
versions.original: ὁ μόνος ἔχων ἀθανασίαν, φῶς οἰκῶν ἀπρόσιτον, ὃν εἶδεν οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ ἰδεῖν δύναται· ᾧ τιμὴ καὶ κράτος αἰώνιον. ἀμήν.

versions.nirv: No one has ever seen God. But the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.
versions.leb: No one has ever seen God. The only God, who is at the Father's side, that one has made him known.
versions.original: Θεὸν οὐδεὶς ἑώρακεν πώποτε· μονογενὴς θεὸς ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κόλπον τοῦ πατρὸς ἐκεῖνος ἐξηγήσατο.

versions.nirv: Jesus left Nazareth. He went and lived in Capernaum. It was by the lake in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali. This happened to bring about what the prophet Isaiah had said: "Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the way to the lake, over the Jordan, Galilee of the nations— the people living in darkness have seen a great light. On those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned." From that time on, Jesus began to preach. He said, "Turn away from your sins. Turn to God. The kingdom of heaven has come near."
versions.leb: And leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali, so that what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah would be fulfilled, saying: "Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles— the people dwelling in darkness have seen a great light, and for those dwelling in the region and shadow of death, a light has dawned upon them." From that time Jesus began to preach and to say, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near."
versions.original: καὶ καταλιπὼν τὴν Ναζαρά, ἐλὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ τὴν παραθαλασσίαν ἐν ὁρίοις Ζαβουλὼν καὶ Νεφθαλείμ· ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος, Γῆ Ζαβουλὼν καὶ γῆ Νεφθαλείμ, ὁδὸν θαλάσσης, πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, Γαλιλαία τῶν ἐθνῶν, ὁ λαὸς ὁ καθήμενος ἐν σκότει φῶς εἶδεν μέγα, καὶ τοῖς καθημένοις ἐν χώρᾳ καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου φῶς ἀνέτειλεν αὐτοῖς. Ἀπὸ τότε ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς κηρύσσειν καὶ λέγειν, Μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

versions.nirv: Follow God’s example, therefore, as dearly loved children and walk in the way of love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us as a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God. Therefore do not be partners with them. For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light (for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness and truth) and find out what pleases the Lord. Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them. It is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret. But everything exposed by the light becomes visible—and everything that is illuminated becomes a light. This is why it is said: "Wake up, sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."
versions.leb: Therefore, be imitators of God, as dearly loved children, and walk in love, just as also Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and sacrifice to God for a fragrant aroma. Therefore do not become partners with them. For you were at one time darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light—for the fruit of the light is in all goodness and righteousness and truth—trying to learn what is pleasing to the Lord. And do not participate in the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even expose them, for it is shameful even to speak of the things happening secretly by them. But all things being exposed by the light are made visible, for everything that makes visible is light. Therefore it says, "Awake, sleeper, and rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."
versions.original: Γίνεσθε οὖν μιμητὴς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὡς τέκνα ἀγαπητά, καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἐν ἀγάπῃ, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν προσφορὰν καὶ θυσίαν τῷ θεῷ εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας. Μὴ οὖν γίνεσθε συμμέτοχοι αὐτῶν· ἦτε γάρ ποτε σκότος, νῦν δὲ φῶς ἐν κυρίῳ· ὡς τέκνα φωτὸς περιπατεῖτε, ὁ γὰρ καρπὸς τοῦ φωτὸς ἐν πάσῃ ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ, δοκιμάζοντες τί ἐστιν εὐάρεστον τῷ κυρίῳ· καὶ μὴ συγκοινωνεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς ἀκάρποις τοῦ σκότους, μᾶλλον δὲ καὶ ἐλέγχετε· τὰ γὰρ κρυφῇ γινόμενα ὑπ' αὐτῶν αἰσχρόν ἐστιν καὶ λέγειν· τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐλεγχόμενα ὑπὸ τοῦ φωτὸς φανεροῦται, πᾶν γὰρ τὸ φανerούμενον φῶς ἐστιν. διὸ λέγει, Ἔγειρε, ὁ καθεύδων, καὶ ἀνάστα ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἐπιφαύσει σοι ὁ Χριστός.

versions.nirv: "Rise up and shine, Jerusalem! Your light has come. The glory of the Lord rises over you. See, darkness covers the earth. Thick darkness covers the nations. But the Lord rises over you. His glory appears over you. Nations will come to your light. Kings will come to the brightness of your dawn. "Look up and look around you. Everyone gathers and comes to you. Your sons come from far away. Your daughters are carried on the hip."
versions.leb: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of Yahweh has dawned upon you. For look, darkness covers the earth, and thick darkness the peoples, but Yahweh will dawn upon you, and his glory will appear over you. And nations will walk by your light, and kings by the brightness of your dawning. Lift up your eyes round about and see: they all gather; they come to you; your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried on the hip."
versions.original: קוּמִי אֹורִי כִּי בָא אֹורֵךְ וּכְבֹוד יְהוָה עָלַיִךְ זָרָח׃ כִּי־הִנֵּה הַחֹשֶׁךְ יְכַסֶּה־אֶרֶץ וַעֲרָפֶ لְאֻמִּים וְעָלַיִךְ יִזְרַח יְהוָה וּכְבֹודֹו עָלַיִךְ יֵרָאֶה׃ וְהָלְכוּ גֹויִם לְאֹורֵךְ וּמְלָכִים לְנֹגַהּ זַרְחֵךְ׃ שְׂئִי־סָבִיב עיניך וְרְאִי כֻּלָּם נִקְبְּצוּ בָאוּ־לָךְ בָּנַיִךְ מֵרָחוֹק יָבֹאוּ וּבְנֹתַיִךְ עַל־צַד תָּאָמַנְהָ׃
